usBooksAndMarketingModules.title: Make It Stick: The Science of Successful Learning (Harvard Belknap Press)
usBooksAndMarketingModules.authors: Peter C. Brown, Henry L. Roediger III, Mark A. McDaniel
usBooksAndMarketingModules.core_insight: US students fall into the "Illusion of Mastery" when re-reading highlighted notes. Effortful retrieval (Feynman blank-page recall), interleaved problem solving, and 72-hour spaced error testing double long-term exam retention.
usBooksAndMarketingModules.site_integration: Applied in Report 2 (Brain & Learning) Chapter 06 Protocol A & Worksheet 01 (Feynman 3-Min Blank-Page Recall) + Month 4 Cornell 72-Hr Error Retrieval.

usBooksAndMarketingModules.title: Why We Sleep: Unlocking the Power of Sleep and Dreams (Scribner)
usBooksAndMarketingModules.authors: Matthew Walker, PhD (UC Berkeley Center for Human Sleep Science)
usBooksAndMarketingModules.core_insight: Deep N3 Slow-Wave Sleep (SWS) in the first 90 minutes after sleep onset drives both peak pituitary Growth Hormone (HGH) release and sleep-spindle transfer of daytime learning from the hippocampus to the neocortex.
usBooksAndMarketingModules.site_integration: Applied in Report 1 Chapter 03 Interactive 24-Hr Nocturnal HGH Simulator and Report 2 Chapter 06 Protocol C (SWS Hippocampal Consolidation).

usBooksAndMarketingModules.title: Smart but Scattered: The Revolutionary "Executive Skills" Approach to Helping Kids Reach Their Potential (Guilford Press)
usBooksAndMarketingModules.authors: Peg Dawson, EdD & Richard Guare, PhD
usBooksAndMarketingModules.core_insight: Smart children who underperform on multi-step math word problems or tests almost always have a bottleneck in Prefrontal Working Memory or Sustained Attention rather than IQ. Externalizing variables visually (Bar Modeling) and matching sprint length to biological age-in-months resolves the bottleneck.
usBooksAndMarketingModules.site_integration: Applied in Report 2 Chapter 05 5-Axis Brain LQ Matrix & Worksheet 02/03 (Visual Math Bar-Modeling Canvas & Timed Focus Sprint Log).
